decisions.executionNote: Bring both arms into continuous elbow-up forward approach; align to the rear-left and front-right white supports before descending.
Align open grippers to the two selected supports with small yaw corrections, descending cautiously; wrist views will refine grasp centers.
Use wrist image offsets to center each support between the fingers, with a slow final descent and grippers open.
Fine-center both white supports, close completely, and make a short test lift to check retention visually.
Both supports remain between the fingers. Lift clear, remove their yaw offsets, and carry them to the paired lower-layer support positions.
Lower the paired supports upright to the table, correcting small tilt and centering errors, then open without lateral motion.
Withdraw open fingers above the placed supports, then spread and turn toward opposite ends of the long lower board, maintaining elbow-up continuity.
Replan from the executed withdrawal: smaller rotation and outward increments toward the long-board end grasps, with open fingers.
Finish the mirrored board-grasp orientations using smaller increments after the continuity guard. Both placed supports are visible upright.
Approach the long board at matched heights from its two ends, keeping fingers open and slowing near the tabletop.
Close both grippers on the long board and lift in synchrony, keeping it level; check visual retention before translating over the supports.
Carry the retained lower board level over the paired upright supports, then begin a slow descent while maintaining matched arm heights.
Seat the lower board gently across the two supports, open both grippers, and withdraw upward and outward to verify stability.
Clear the completed lower layer and turn gradually toward the remaining left and right white supports with open grippers.
Complete the gradual turns and approach above the two remaining white blocks; use the next wrist views for precise centering.
Refine the remaining support grasps using wrist offsets, matching the right block's yaw while descending slowly with open fingers.
Center and test-lift the left block. The right approach shows obstruction near the lower board, so withdraw upward/outward and begin a side approach rather than forcing descent.
The left block is retained; raise it above the lower layer before carrying inward. Continue the right arm's gradual side approach with open fingers.
Carry the left middle support above its placement point. Finish the right side-facing orientation and cautiously approach the remaining block clear of the lower board.
Seat and release the left middle support. Correct the right wrist's lateral image offset toward the rear block while keeping its side approach open and slow.
Withdraw the left hand from the released support. Recenter the right block between open fingers with small lateral corrections; its yaw changed, so verify before closing.
Center and close on the right support, then test-lift it. Begin turning the clear left gripper toward the middle board while staying above it.
The right support is retained. Lift it clear, then begin turning it upright into the same alignment as the left support. Finish the left approach above the middle board.
After the continuity rejection, use very small inward and backward increments with the retained right block. Continue the left open-gripper alignment above the middle board.
Continue carrying and yaw-aligning the retained right middle support above the lower layer. Park the left open gripper at the middle board's left end.
Move the right support above its symmetric middle-layer location and finish its yaw alignment, keeping height unchanged until placement clearance is visible.
Lower the right support slowly above the lower board, compensating its forward offset in the grasp; pause near contact to verify alignment before release.
Finish the gentle right-support placement, open and let it settle centered on the lower board, then withdraw vertically and backward for a clear stability check.
The right support is released and remains upright in the wrist view. Move the right hand clear and turn toward the middle board's right end.
Finish the right board-end orientation and descend toward the middle board, matching the waiting left gripper without touching the completed lower layer.
Match both middle-board end grasps, close the grippers, and make a synchronized short lift to verify retention.
The middle board is retained between both grippers. Equalize their heights, lift level above the middle supports, and begin translating toward the tower.
Translate the middle board level above the two upright middle supports, keeping both grippers closed and its center aligned with the lower layer.
Seat the middle board level on the paired supports, open both grippers, and start withdrawing without disturbing the upright layers.
Withdraw clear of the stable middle layer. Approach the small brown top board with the left arm and the green roof with the right, keeping each arm in its own workspace.
Align the left gripper frontally over the small board and the right gripper from the outside over the roof, descending only to a visual pregrasp height.
Use wrist-image offsets to center the small board and roof between open fingers, with a slow descent and no closing until their alignment is clear.
Fine-center the top pieces, align the roof's yaw, close both grippers, and make a short test lift before transport.
Both top pieces appear retained. Lift clear of the table, gradually turn the brown board across the tower, and restore the roof's upright yaw alignment.
Carry the brown board toward the center at clearance height while turning it across the middle board. Hold the roof safely to the right until the board is placed.
Finish centering and aligning the small brown board across the tower; begin lowering only near the centered pose. Keep the roof held clear on the right.
Seat the centered brown board gently on the middle layer, release it, and withdraw the left fingers while keeping the roof safely held aside.
Carry the upright roof above the centered brown board at clearance height. Move the empty left hand away from the tower and start its gradual return.
Lower the roof slowly over the brown board while correcting its small horizontal offset. Continue the empty left arm's elbow-up return toward origin.
Seat and release the roof gently, then withdraw the right fingers upward and outward. Finish returning the empty left arm to its starting pose.
The roof is released and remains on the brown board. Withdraw the right arm clear of the tower and rotate gradually toward origin, keeping both grippers open.
Return the right arm to its starting pose with decreasing final increments. Keep both grippers open and leave the completed tower undisturbed.
